reports.title: Mutual NDA — Acme Corp × Your Startup

clauses.title: §5.2 — Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Each party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000).

clauses.title: §6.1 — Indemnification
clauses.text: Receiving Party shall indemnify Disclosing Party for any and all claims without limitation of amount.

clauses.title: §3.1 — Confidential Information
clauses.text: Confidential Information means all non-public information disclosed under this Agreement.

clauses.title: §4.2 — Permitted Disclosures
clauses.text: Recipient may disclose only as required by law with prompt notice to Discloser.

clauses.title: §7.1 — Term
clauses.text: This Agreement remains in effect for three (3) years from the Effective Date.

clauses.title: §8.3 — Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.

contradictions.description: Liability is capped at $10,000 in §5.2 while §6.1 requires uncapped indemnification — you absorb unlimited downside with minimal recovery.

compliance_issues.issue: Breach notification window may be tighter than 72-hour regulatory expectation for EU data subjects.

proposals.original: Receiving Party shall indemnify Disclosing Party for any and all claims without limitation of amount.
proposals.proposed: Each party's indemnification obligation shall be subject to the aggregate liability cap in Section 5.2, except for fraud or willful misconduct.
proposals.issue_detected: Uncapped indemnity conflicts with liability cap
proposals.rationale: Aligns indemnity exposure with the stated liability ceiling.

reports.report: Executive summary: NEGOTIATE before signature. Direct contradiction between liability cap and indemnity. One compliance note on breach notification.

contract_intent.deal_thesis: Mutual confidentiality to enable diligence ahead of a strategic partnership.
